# Variables sub-actions

## Clear temporary global variables

Deletes all global variables that are not kept after a restart. Variables you kept are not touched. Good for a fresh start at the beginning of a stream.

<small>Type id: `core.clearTemporaryGlobals`</small>

## Clear temporary user variables

Deletes the viewer variables that are not kept after a restart, for everyone. Kept ones stay. Good for a fresh start, like resetting a quiz.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | Only clear for viewers on this site, like twitch. Empty = all sites. |

<small>Type id: `core.clearTemporaryUserVariables`</small>

## Delete global variable

Deletes a global variable, so it is gone. Good to reset something like a counter completely.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Variable name** | The variable's name without the ~ signs, like "deaths". |

<small>Type id: `core.deleteGlobal`</small>

## Delete user variable

Deletes a variable that belongs to one viewer, or to every viewer. Good to reset something like a quiz score.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Variable name** | The variable's name, like "score". |
| **Platform** | The site the viewer is on, like twitch. Empty = the site of whoever started the action. |
| **User id** | The viewer's id on their site. Empty = the viewer who started the action, or the one found by user name. |
| **User name** | The viewer's chat name, like "kris". Used to find the viewer when you give no id. |
| **For all users** | Tick to delete it from every viewer of that site (all sites if Platform is empty), not just one. Starts as: `false`. |

<small>Type id: `core.deleteUserVariable`</small>

## Get global variable

Reads a global variable and puts its value in a normal variable you can use with %name%. Needed when you want to check a remembered value, like a death count.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Variable name** | The global variable's name without the ~ signs, like "deaths". |
| **Save in variable** | The variable that receives the value, without % signs. Empty = same name as the global variable. |
| **Default value** | The value to use if the global variable does not exist yet. Empty = leave the variable unset. |
| **Auto type** | Tick so numbers stay real numbers (needed for greater/less than checks). Normally leave it ticked. Starts as: `true`. |

<small>Type id: `core.getGlobal`</small>

## Get user variable

Reads a variable that belongs to one viewer, like their score, and puts the value in a normal variable you can use with %name%.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Variable name** | The viewer variable's name, like "score". |
| **Platform** | The site the viewer is on, like twitch. Empty = the site of whoever started the action. |
| **User id** | The viewer's id on their site. Empty = the viewer who started the action, or the one found by user name. |
| **User name** | The viewer's chat name, like "kris". Used to find the viewer when you give no id. |
| **Save in variable** | The variable that receives the value, without % signs. Empty = same name as the viewer variable. |
| **Default value** | The value to use if the viewer or variable does not exist. Empty = leave the variable unset. |
| **Auto type** | Tick so numbers stay real numbers (needed for greater/less than checks). Normally leave it ticked. Starts as: `true`. |

<small>Type id: `core.getUserVariable`</small>

## Pick color

Picks a color and saves it in several formats for other steps, like OBS or a light. Pick the color while editing, run it, then use %color.html% and friends.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Color** | The color as hex digits: #RRGGBB, like #FF9146, or #AARRGGBB when you want see-through (alpha). Starts as: `#FF9146FF`. |
| **Variable name** | A name for the result variables, without %. With "color" you get %color.html% and the others. Starts as: `color`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%color.html%` | The color as #RRGGBB (name is the one you chose) |
| `%color.htmlalpha%` | The color as #AARRGGBB, including see-through |
| `%color.obs%` | The color as a number in the format OBS expects |
| `%color.color.r%` | The red part, 0 to 255 (g = green, b = blue, a = see-through) |

<small>Type id: `core.pickColor`</small>

## Random number

Picks a random number, like rolling a dice, and saves it in a variable. Good for "roll 1 to 100" commands or a chance for something to happen.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Type** | Between = a whole number from Minimum to Maximum. Next Float = a number from 0 to 1, plus a percent from 0 to 100. Options: Between, Next Float. Starts as: `Between`. |
| **Save in variable** | The variable that gets the number, without % signs. Default random means you use %random%. Only for Between. Starts as: `random`. |
| **Minimum** | The lowest number that can be picked, like 1. Starts as: `1`. |
| **Maximum (inclusive)** | The highest number that can be picked, like 100. This number can be picked too. Starts as: `100`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%random%` | The number that was picked (the variable name can be changed) |
| `%randomFloat%` | Only with Next Float: a number from 0 up to just below 1 |
| `%randomPercent%` | Only with Next Float: the same as a whole percent, 0 to 100 |

<small>Type id: `core.randomNumber`</small>

## Set global variable

Saves a value that every action can read later as ~name~, like a death counter. It can set it or count up and down. Kept after a restart by default.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Variable name** | The variable's name, like "deaths". Use it anywhere as ~deaths~. |
| **Mode** | Value = save exactly what you type. Increment = add to the current number. Decrement = subtract from it. Options: Value, Increment, Decrement. Starts as: `Value`. |
| **Value** | With Value: what to save. With Increment/Decrement: how much to add or subtract (empty = 1). |
| **Keep after restart** | Tick to keep it after Cuebot restarts. Untick for a temporary value that vanishes when Cuebot closes. Starts as: `true`. |
| **Auto type** | Tick so numbers and true/false are stored as real numbers/yes-no values and not plain text. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Also save in variable** | Optional. A variable to also receive the new value, without % signs, so you can use %name% in the next steps. |

<small>Type id: `core.setGlobal`</small>

## Set user variable

Saves a value that belongs to one viewer, like their score or favorite color. It can set it or count up and down. Kept after a restart by default.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Variable name** | The variable's name, like "score". |
| **Platform** | The site the viewer is on, like twitch. Empty = the site of whoever started the action. |
| **User id** | The viewer's id on their site. Empty = the viewer who started the action, or the one found by user name. |
| **User name** | The viewer's chat name, like "kris". Used to find the viewer when you give no id. |
| **Mode** | Value = save exactly what you type. Increment = add to the current number. Decrement = subtract from it. Options: Value, Increment, Decrement. Starts as: `Value`. |
| **Value** | With Value: what to save. With Increment/Decrement: how much to add or subtract (empty = 1). |
| **Keep after restart** | Tick to keep it after Cuebot restarts. Untick for a temporary value that vanishes when Cuebot closes. Starts as: `true`. |
| **Auto type** | Tick so numbers and true/false are stored as real numbers/yes-no values and not plain text. Starts as: `true`. |
| **Also save in variable** | Optional. A variable to also receive the new value, without % signs, so you can use %name% in the next steps. |

<small>Type id: `core.setUserVariable`</small>

## Set variable

Creates a variable for this run only, or changes it. Use it afterwards as %name%. Good for building a message or counting inside one action.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Variable name** | The variable's name without % signs, like "greeting". Use it later as %greeting%. |
| **Value** | What to store. You can mix %variables%, ~global variables~ and math like $math(%count% + 1)$. |
| **Auto type** | Tick so numbers and true/false are stored as real numbers/yes-no values and not plain text. Needed for greater/less than checks. Starts as: `false`. |

<small>Type id: `core.setArgument`</small>
